'''''Axioms''''' is a [[peer-reviewed]] [[open access]] [[scientific journal]] that focuses on all aspects of [[mathematics]], [[mathematical logic]], and [[mathematical physics]]. It was established in 2012 and is published quarterly by [[MDPI]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=Axioms |url=https://www.mdpi.com/journal/axioms |access-date=2022-02-22 |website=www.mdpi.com}}</ref> a publisher whose practices have been frequently and thoroughly called into question.<ref>{{cite web
 |title=Caution: MDPI journals of variable quality
 |website=Radboud University
 |date=24 September 2024
 |url=https://www.ru.nl/en/staff/news/caution-mdpi-journals-of-variable-quality
 |access-date=7 March 2026
}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal
 |last=Oviedo-García
 |first=M. Ángeles
 |title=Journal citation reports and the definition of a predatory journal: The case of the Multidisciplinary Digital Publishing Institute (MDPI)
 |journal=Research Evaluation
 |volume=30
 |issue=3
 |pages=405–419
 |date=July 2021
 |doi=10.1093/reseval/rvab020
|hdl=11441/128366
 |hdl-access=free
 }} {{Expression of Concern|doi=10.1093/reseval/rvab030|https://retractionwatch.com/2023/05/08/article-that-assessed-mdpi-journals-as-predatory-retracted-and-replaced/ ''Retraction Watch''|resolved=yes|intentional=yes}} {{Erratum|doi=10.1093/reseval/rvad014|checked=yes}}</ref> The [[editor-in-chief]] is Humberto Bustince ([[Public University of Navarre]]). Axioms was discontinued in Scopus.<ref name="retractionwatch.com">{{cite web |last1=Kincaid |first1=Ellie |title=Exclusive: MDPI journal undergoing reevaluation at Scopus, indexing on hold |url=https://retractionwatch.com/2024/01/02/exclusive-mdpi-journal-undergoing-reevaluation-at-scopus-indexing-on-hold/#more-128493 |website=Retraction Watch |access-date=2024-01-03 |date=2 January 2024}}</ref>

==Abstracting and indexing==
The journal is abstracted and indexed in:
*[[EBSCO databases]]<ref name=MIAR>{{cite MIAR |title=Axioms |issn=2075-1680 |access-date=2024-12-11}}</ref>
*[[ProQuest databases]]<ref name=MIAR/>
*[[Science Citation Index Expanded]]
*[[Scopus]] (2012–2023)<ref name="retractionwatch.com"/><ref name=Scopus>{{cite web |url=https://www.scopus.com/sourceid/21100830706 |title=Source details: Axioms |publisher=[[Elsevier]] |work=Scopus Preview |access-date=2024-12-11}}</ref>
*[[zbMATH Open]] (2012–2019)<ref name=MATH>{{cite web |url=https://zbmath.org/serials/?q=axioms |title=Serials Search Results |publisher=[[Springer Science+Business Media]] |work=[[zbMATH Open]] |access-date=2024-12-11}}</ref>
According to the ''[[Journal Citation Reports]]'', the journal has a 2024 [[impact factor]] of 1.6.<ref name=WoS>{{cite book |year=2025 |chapter=Axioms |title=2024 Journal Citation Reports |publisher=[[Clarivate]] |edition=Science |via=[[Web of Science]] |title-link=Journal Citation Reports}}</ref>
